steps.name: Step 1 — Navigate to Settings -> Analytics, click the Agents & Pipelines tab
Step 2 — Verify the "Most Active Agents & Pipelines" bar chart is shown with subtitle "Top {N} by runs" and N matching the visible row total
Step 3 — Verify the "Chat Messages" area chart is shown with subtitle "User messages per day"

Step 4 — Verify the "Agent & Pipeline Activity" table header shows "{N} agents & pipelines" matching the pagination total, and pagination controls (rows-per-page 20, range label, prev disabled / next enabled for a > 1 page total)
Step 7 — Verify a "Search by agent or pipeline name" input is present, positioned top-right of the Agent & Pipeline Activity card
Step 5 — Verify the table header column SET/order: 8 columns for the current personal project ('Private'), 9 (Users inserted after Runs) after switching to a non-personal project ('UI Testing')
